content.rendered:
DIVINE ENFORCEMENT

“Then I came to the governors beyond the river, and gave them the king’s letters. Now the king had sent captains of the army and horsemen with me.” (Nehemiah 2: 9)

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.

Prior to our Focal Scripture, Nehemiah requested for letters to be sent to governors of regions, to facilitate his movement. He also sought a letter to Asaph, keeper of the king’s forest. He did not request for military presence, but the king sent captains of the army, with horsemen, to accompany Nehemiah.

The king sent men that will enforce his wishes for Nehemiah. The king sent men that will compel everyone involved to favour Nehemiah.

Friend, for every word that God has spoken concerning you, there shall be enforcement. God will send angels to enforce every word He has spoken concerning you; God will send His heavenly armies to fight against anyone who opposes His word for your life; God will send the heavenly horsemen to rise and cut short every power of hell that wants to cut short your destiny. Your prophecy shall attract heaven’s enforcement.

There may have been people who would look down on Nehemiah because he was a captive; there would have been people who would refuse to comply with the king’s directives concerning Nehemiah, and the king made arrangements to take care of any opposition. Hear me as I hear the Lord: every opposition to your advancement shall be divinely dealt with; every man that wants to halt you will be halted by heaven.

Nehemiah got a military reinforcement that enabled his mission to be accomplished. Get set: for every mission in your life that heaven has endorsed, there shall be a divine military enforcement. The armies of heaven will compel your environment and those that are therein to cooperate with you for your advancement. The armies of heaven shall crush every satanic conspiracy against your progress and advancement.

The season of being stopped by your opposers, is over. In this season, there shall be divine military enforcement of your wishes and desires.

Jeremiah 1: 12 says: “Then said the LORD unto me, Thou hast well seen: for I will hasten my word to perform it.”

Declare With Me: I receive divine enforcement for every word of the Lord for my life, in Jesus’ name!
